n-m-e3-s2b-05.goal: Follow new information to fix where comparing only numerators works or fails for fractions with same denominator, then choose a way to compare mixed and improper fractions.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.material: Hajun and Seoa play game where dem draw fraction cards and the bigger one win. Cards get fractions like 3/4 and fractions with whole number plus fraction, like 2 1/4. Hajun first think one rule. Each time new card show, check whether that rule correct.

n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.prompt: Choose how your thinking change each time a new card show.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.hint.0: At each step, first write, "If I use Hajun rule, wetin happen with this card?"

n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.info: One pizza divide equally into 4 pieces. Card 가 na 3/4 and card 나 na 5/4. Hajun talk, "The denominators na the same, so the one with bigger numerator bigger."
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wetin you think about Hajun talk?
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.after: If denominators same, each piece get same size, so the fraction with more pieces (numerator) bigger.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Denominators same, so both fractions same size.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: If denominators same, only the size of each piece na same; number of pieces different.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: The pieces get same size, so 5/4, with more pieces, bigger.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: If pieces plenty, dem become smaller, so 5/4 smaller.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Pieces become smaller when denominator bigger. Here denominators same and only number of pieces (numerator) different.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: You only fit tell which bigger by drawing picture.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Picture help, but if you use the fact that pieces get same size, you fit tell without picture.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Card 다 na 2 1/4 (2 and 1/4), and card 라 na 7/4. Using the same method, Hajun talk, "The numerator of 2 1/4 na 1 and the numerator of 7/4 na 7, so card 라 bigger."
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Numerator 1 in 2 1/4 na number of leftover pieces apart from the 2 whole pizzas. If you compare only numerators, you leave out the 2 whole number in front.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Denominators same, so this time too you only need look at numerators.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Think about say numerator 1 in mixed number just count the pieces after the whole number 2.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mixed numbers smaller than improper fractions, so card 라 bigger.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: No such rule between mixed numbers and improper fractions. Size depend on the numbers.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: 2 1/4 get whole number 2 too, so you must consider am.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Both get fourths, so dem get same size.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Same denominator no mean the two numbers equal.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Hajun draw 7/4 as picture. 4 pieces make one pizza and 3 pieces remain. Now make we work out which bigger: 2 1/4 or 7/4.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Which card bigger, and wetin be good way to compare dem?
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.2.after: 7/4 na one pizza and 3 pieces, and 2 1/4 na two pizzas and 1 piece, so card 다 bigger. Changing to 9/4 and 7/4 to compare give the same result.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Card 라 bigger because numerator 7 bigger than 1.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: This thinking use numerator comparison wey wrong for previous step.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Dem equal because both get denominator 4.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Same denominator different from same size.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s3.r.b: Same denominator different from same size.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: You no fit compare because mixed numbers and improper fractions na different kinds.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s3.o.d: You no fit compare because mixed numbers and improper fractions na different kinds.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Even if dem different types, you fit compare dem if you change dem to same form.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s3.r.d: Even if dem different types, you fit compare dem if you change dem to same form.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Card 다 bigger. Change both to same form and compare.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.3.info: This time cards na card 마, 3 2/5, and card 바, 3 4/5.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.3.ask: Wetin go be good way to compare dem this time?
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.3.after: If whole number parts na the same, compare only fraction parts. If whole number parts different, the one with bigger whole number part bigger.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.3.o.a: The whole number parts na the same, so compare fraction parts 2/5 and 4/5.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.3.o.b: The whole number parts na the same, so both cards get the same size.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.3.r.b: This thinking miss say fraction parts different.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.3.o.c: You fit compare mixed numbers only after changing dem to improper fractions.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.3.r.c: You fit change dem to improper fractions, but you no need do so.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Always remove the whole number part and look only at the fraction part.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.3.r.d: This time the answer correct, but e no work when the whole number parts different, like 3 2/5 and 2 4/5. Na method wey you fit use only when whole number parts same.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.reflect: The first rule correct when comparing proper fractions or improper fractions with same denominator. When mixed numbers come, looking only at numerator wrong because e leave out whole number part. Changing dem to same form solve am, and for mixed numbers with same whole number part, comparing only fraction parts work. Talk how far the rule correct.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s2.prompt: Among mixed numbers with denominator 4, make three different ones bigger than 7/4. Whole number part na w and fraction part na n/4. (n na one of 1, 2, or 3.)
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s2.hint.0: Choose a mixed number and rewrite am as some fourths (an improper fraction).
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s2.hint.1: Compare the numerator of that improper fraction with 7.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s2.ok.c1: w and n na natural numbers.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Abeg make w natural number 1 or more, and n natural number.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Fraction part na proper fraction (n na 1, 2, or 3).
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Must be number bigger than 7/4. One pizza na 4 pieces, so change am to total number of pieces and compare.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s2.explain: 1 3/4 equal 7/4, and to be bigger than that, the whole number part must be 2 or more. 1 1/4 and 1 2/4, wey smaller than 1 3/4, smaller than 7/4.
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s3.prompt: Card 사 na 3 1/5, and card 아 na 13/5. How you fit compare dem correctly, and which card bigger?
n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s3.hint.0: Use Hajun first rule (look only at numerators) for the two cards. Compare that answer with the result from drawing picture.

n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s3.o.a: Card 아 bigger because numerator 13 bigger than 1.

n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s3.explain: 3 1/5, when one pizza get 5 pieces, na 3 pizzas and 1 piece, so 16 pieces. 13/5 na 13 pieces. If you change dem to same form and compare 16/5 and 13/5, card 사 bigger. Comparing only numerators 1 and 13 as dem be na wrong.
